toolResult.reason:
Wrote design.md, spec.md, tasks.md under specrunner/changes/noop-detect-finding-target-exemption/ for the no-op finding-target exemption change.

Design summary:
- D1: Add a pure `collectRoutedFixerFindings(state)` in a new light module `src/core/step/routed-findings.ts` that mirrors code-fixer.buildMessage's routing precedence (conformance → coordinator-loop → active-reviewer), reusing existing state seams (getConformanceFixContext / collectParallelFixerFindings / getLatestJudgeFindings / resolveActiveReviewer / deriveImplFixerChain). Relocate the private predicates isCoordinatorLoopActive / getNeedsFixMembers from code-fixer.ts into this module (behavior unchanged) so both code-fixer and the executor share the same routing predicates — the exemption set is faithfully "findings routed to THIS run" (not a superset → no sabotage fail-open; not a subset → no false escalation). New module is import-cycle-safe and keeps agent/prompt deps out of executor's graph; reviewer-chain.ts rejected because CUSTOM_REVIEWERS_STEP_NAME would create a reviewer-chain↔pipeline/types cycle. Agent self-report is not an input.
- D2: detectNoOp gains optional findingTargetPaths + pipelineManagedPaths params. sourceFiles filter exempts finding-named paths from ARTIFACT_PREFIXES, but subtracts pipelineManagedPaths inside the detector (exempt = findingTargetPaths − pipelineManagedPaths) so the cap tooth is local. Params default to empty → prior behavior byte-identical.
- D3: executor computes findingTargetPaths only when step.noOpDetect===true (guard) and passes pipelineManagedPaths(deps.slug); findingsRoutingApproved / completionReason / sourceFiles>0 paths unchanged.

tasks.md T-01..T-05 cover the module + code-fixer refactor, detectNoOp, executor wiring, and the four acceptance-criteria scenario tests (#927 doc exemption, non-target change-folder file → needs-fix, pipelineManagedPaths cap → needs-fix, src-only normal case) plus existing-test preservation and typecheck+test. No src/ edits performed — planning only.
